articles.title: Privacy returns to focus as Ethereum developers explore new token standards
articles.snippet: In this week's edition of The Protocol Newsletter, we're looking at where privacy is headed in the Ethereum ecosystem.

articles.title: Crypto Long & Short: Who answers the 3am call when DeFi breaks?
articles.snippet: In this week's Crypto Long & Short, Ben Nadareski writes that to win over big investors, DeFi builders must act like accountable money managers, not just software developers. Then, Stephen Stonberg says that bitcoin holders can survive crashes and protect their assets by earning income through reinsurance.

articles.title: Prediction markets get first U.S. rule proposal as CFTC pursues contract reviews
articles.snippet: The Commodity Futures Trading Commission opened a proposed rule for public comment that sets an approach to determine contracts in the "public interest."

articles.title: CoinDesk 20 performance update: Index drops 1.4% as all constituents decline
articles.snippet: Bitcoin Cash (BCH) fell 4.1% and NEAR Protocol (NEAR) shed 4.3%, leading the index lower.

articles.title: Japan's three largest banks aim for joint stablecoin issue by March
articles.snippet: MUFG, SMBC and Mizuho will establish a council to explore operational frameworks and prepare for the issuance of stablecoins.
